test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Divyansh invested 1/4 of his capital at 10%, 1/5 at 20% and the remaining at 30% simple interest per annum, respectively. If his annual income is₹3,220, then find the capital (in₹).
solution:
**Given:**

Capital fractions: 1/4 at 10%, 1/5 at 20%, remaining at 30%

Annual Income = ₹3220

Time = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

S.I. = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let capital = C.

Remaining capital fraction = 1 - 1/4 - 1/5 = 11/20

Interest = (1/4C × 10 × 1)/100 + (1/5C × 20 × 1)/100 + (11/20C × 30 × 1)/100

⇒ 3220 = C/40 + C/25 + 33C/200

⇒ 3220 = (5C + 8C + 33C) / 200

⇒ 3220 × 200 = 46C

⇒ C = 14000

**∴ The capital is ₹14,000.**

5b
